title: Playboy Magazine March 1966 Ian Fleming Octopussy James Bond Nabokov
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, spine wear or address label. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, March 1966 issue. Cover price 75 cents.

Features:
- "Octopussy" - a previously unpublished Ian Fleming James Bond adventure, in which Bond pursues a British agent turned thief and murderer
- Plus Nabokov, Di Donato and Hentoff
- Three Fresh European Sex Sirens

Snow bunny cover.

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
